info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Advisory Engagements API
info.description: The Legal Advisory Engagements API facilitates the management of engagements between enterprises and legal advisors. This API enables organizations to initiate and configure new legal advisory engagements, ensuring streamlined collaboration and compliance. Typical consumers include legal teams, finance departments, and enterprise risk management professionals. By using this API, businesses can enhance their legal advisory processes and maintain organized records of engagements.

post.summary: Create a new legal advisory engagement.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate and create a new legal advisory engagement. Ensure that all required information is provided in the request to successfully process the engagement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new engagement in the legal advisory service. It requires the necessary information about the engagement, which will be processed to initiate the advisory services.
